recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結免疫組化中，多個淡染陰性的濾泡周圍與濾泡間可見成簇的褐色陽性細胞密集聚集，副皮質區有大量散在陽性細胞，顯示 T 細胞區擴張；配合臨床可支持 ALPS，但標記未標示。
features: Low-power IHC of lymph node with multiple pale, negative-staining follicles
Dense clusters of positive (brown) cells around and between follicles
Numerous scattered positive cells diffusely distributed through the expanded paracortex
Antibody not labeled; staining is nuclear/cytoplasmic granular at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of lymph node shows preserved architecture with negative follicles and an expanded interfollicular/paracortical compartment containing numerous scattered positive cells and dense perifollicular clusters. The antibody is not identified, so the lineage of the positive cells cannot be assigned with certainty from this image alone. A T-zone expansion pattern of this type is compatible with autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome in the appropriate clinical setting; confirmation requires CD3/CD4/CD8 staining showing double-negative T cells, flow cytometric quantitation of TCRαβ+ DNT cells, and FAS-pathway genetic testing.

ddx.vs: T cells retain CD4 or CD8 expression and double-negative T cells are not increased.
Contains CD30/CD15-positive Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells within the interfollicular infiltrate.
Effaces architecture with atypical, clonal T cells and aberrant antigen loss.
